description: This file defines the NestedIntNode class and related functions for handling nested integer symbolic nodes within the PyTorch framework, including comparison and multiplication operations, and string representations.

classes.name: NestedIntNode
classes.description: Represents a nested integer symbolic node with methods for comparison, multiplication, and string representation.

methods.name: _eq
methods.description: Checks equality between two NestedIntNode instances.

methods.name: _ge
methods.description: Checks if one NestedIntNode is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a NestedIntNode with a type id and coefficient.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.nested_int_coeff
methods.description: Returns the coefficient of the node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.maybe_as_int
methods.description: Placeholder for converting to int, returns None.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_int
methods.description: Returns True indicating this node is an integer.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_float
methods.description: Returns False indicating this node is not a float.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_bool
methods.description: Returns False indicating this node is not a boolean.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_nested_int
methods.description: Returns True indicating this is a nested int node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode._str
methods.description: Internal method for string representation.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.str
methods.description: Returns string representation of the node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.__str__
methods.description: String representation of the node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.__repr__
methods.description: Official string representation of the node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode._graph_repr
methods.description: Graph visualization string.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.mul
methods.description: Multiplies the node by a constant or symbolic value.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.eq
methods.description: Checks equality with another node, returns a symbolic boolean.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.ne
methods.description: Checks inequality with another node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.gt
methods.description: Checks if greater than another node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.lt
methods.description: Checks if less than another node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.le
methods.description: Checks if less than or equal to another node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.ge
methods.description: Checks if greater than or equal to another node.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_symbolic
methods.description: Indicates whether the node is symbolic; returns False.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.nested_int
methods.description: Returns the type id of the nested int.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.is_constant
methods.description: Indicates whether the node is a constant; returns False.

methods.name: NestedIntNode.wrap_int
methods.description: Wraps an integer into a ConstantIntNode.
